purpose: Bind the complete corrected Dense publication renderer before corrected validation, BEIR, geometry, outcome, bridge, sensitivity, or publication outputs exist.
prospective_plan_status: The parent protocols froze the estimands, uncertainty procedure, geometry features, held-out bridge rule, execution-sensitivity comparison, and claim boundaries before their corrected outputs existed. This lock fixes how every result is validated and rendered rather than introducing a new analysis.

visibility_at_implementation_freeze.corrected_checkpoint_state: Two active AdamW runs had written checkpoint-782 and were at step 1180; no checkpoint tensor was read to design, tune, or test the renderer.

input_contract.outcome: Require the complete source-bound 840-unit outcome manifest, all three primary and secondary contrasts, all 15 optimizer-stage rows, all 12 validation rows, all 12 system rows, and the exact validation-selection receipt.
input_contract.geometry: Require the complete source-bound 60-row checkpoint geometry and 660 run-pair subspace manifest.
input_contract.bridge: Require all nine frozen features, all 36 leave-dose fold rows in its coverage receipt, and recompute the pooled-RMSE plus at-least-three-of-four-fold support rule.
input_contract.sensitivity: Require all 60 matched rows in its coverage receipt, ten optimizer-minus-AdamW stage contrasts, five rankings, and no pooling.
input_contract.provenance: Verify every upstream protocol hash plus each consumed file's byte count, SHA-256, and row count before rendering. Fail closed on any mismatch.

rendering_contract.primary: Render all three four-rate simultaneous max-T contrasts as the headline result.
rendering_contract.secondary: Render all three independently padded validation-selected simultaneous max-T contrasts and identify both selected run IDs.
rendering_contract.dynamics: Render all 15 optimizer-by-stage four-rate mean and median retrieval rows.
rendering_contract.systems: Render four-rate optimizer means without selecting a favorable rate.
rendering_contract.geometry: Render final-stage four-rate optimizer means for segment magnitude, stable/effective rank, row concentration, and cumulative displacement.
rendering_contract.bridge: Render all nine frozen features regardless of support, including held-out RMSE reduction, improved-fold count, and descriptive residual correlations.
rendering_contract.sensitivity: Render all ten execution contrasts and five optimizer rankings only in the standalone repository engineering report; exclude them from every manuscript section and generated manuscript macro.
rendering_contract.paper_placement: Define one source-bound all-rate finding for the abstract and main Conclusion. Keep the three-contrast all-rate retrieval table and reached-weight-state summaries in the scientific narrative, and the complete nine-feature retrieval-bridge table in the appendix. Historical selector claims, execution incidents and implementation-error analyses remain repository provenance and do not enter the manuscript or its appendix.
rendering_contract.destinations: Write one standalone Markdown evidence report, write the paper include paper/generated/optimizer-primary.tex, and emit a source-addressed summary manifest.

paper_only_amendment.reason: The owner retired the parallel Markdown article deliverable. The renderer now writes only the source-bound standalone evidence report, manuscript include, and manifest.

layout_only_amendment.reason: A result-blind topology fixture matching the frozen renderer moved the manuscript endpoint from page 8 to page 9 and exposed an over-wide primary table. Keep the primary all-rate answer in the main story, move the complete bridge and execution-sensitivity readouts to the appendix, and shorten the primary header without changing any input, estimand, row, interval, support rule, conclusion branch, or standalone evidence output.

narrative_outcome_amendment.reason: A second result-blind manuscript audit found that the final renderer placed the corrected verdict only in its results section: the abstract and main Conclusion could therefore keep foregrounding historical packed-selector evidence after corrected outputs arrived. Render one identical source-bound all-rate finding into the abstract and main Conclusion, keep the full corrected analysis in the main results section, and move the complete historical selector claim string to the appendix.
narrative_outcome_amendment.abstract_and_conclusion_source: the same primary all-rate Muon-versus-AdamW and NorMuon-versus-AdamW simultaneous-interval rows already required by the frozen outcome protocol

owner_scientific_scope_amendment.reason: The owner requires a scientific weight-space narrative and excludes implementation-error stories from the entire manuscript. This active rendering contract follows that instruction; earlier amendments above remain historical records.

complete_paper_compile_amendment.reason: A full synthetic-results paper compile exposed literal backslash-n text after two table-header row terminators. Emit an actual newline before the midrule. No inputs, numbers, estimands, support rules or scientific wording change.

publication_reconstruction_amendment.reason: The final manuscript gate must independently re-read the bound upstream evidence and reproduce exact primary LaTeX, report text, coverage and conclusion; a non-pending include or self-consistent edited digest is insufficient.

claim_boundary: The corrected conclusion is one-seed, pinned-grid evidence. The primary comparison averages every predeclared rate; validation selection is secondary; all nine geometry features must be disclosed. Predictive geometry support is not causal mediation, and historical-versus-corrected shifts are execution-path sensitivity rather than a randomized causal effect of packing.

evaluation_handoff_amendment.reason: Authenticate the exact corrected Dense evaluation source mapping before outcome aggregation; preserve all scientific and numerical definitions.
